title: Is Instinct safe to use? Three things to know before you sign up

reading.body:
The incident cannot be evaluated. The only source provided is a headline from Norton's blog, but the article text itself was not captured or made available, so what the reporting actually said about safety concerns is not established.

Without access to the article's content, it is not possible to identify what kind of failure occurred, where in any deployment it happened, or what checks might have prevented it.

summary:
I appreciate you sharing this content, but the article text you've provided appears to be CSS code and styling information rather than actual news article content about Instinct's safety.

The material consists entirely of technical CSS styling rules for a privacy consent banner/modal interface and contains no information about:
- What Instinct is
- Safety concerns or assessments
- Three things to know before signing up
- Any actual news reporting

To provide you with an accurate summary, I would need the actual article text that discusses Instinct and addresses the headline's question about its safety. Could you please share the body text of the article itself?
